paragraphs.text: The Source Material Cards bonus sheet is a collection of additional cards that will be released alongside Avatar: The Last Airbender on November 21, 2025. It contains reprinted cards themed for Avatar: The Last Airbender with iconic art from the TV series.

Every Source Material card is a screenshot of a separate episode. The cards feature "book" and "chapter" numbers, and there's exactly one from each episode/chapter, annotated in the information below the text box .
These source material cards are Commander -, Legacy -, and Vintage -legal. Individual cards are also legal where already available in other formats.

A non-foil source material card appears in every 1 of 26 Play Boosters . Each Collector Booster contains a non-foil or traditional foil source material card. There are 61 different source material cards. Each source material card appears at the same rate. They are all Mythic Rare .

Since cards in the bonus sheet used art taken directly from the cartoon, each image is at the resolution of the original screening. Many community members considered them aesthetically unappealing. Many were also criticized for having little or no flavorful link to the mechanics of the card.
